requirements.title: The account sits behind an AccountClient interface whose in-memory fake starts at $250.00 with 8 contacts, and whose send can be made to fail
Typing in the contact search filters the contact list by name, ignoring case
Tapping a contact opens the amount screen for that contact
The keypad enters digits, a decimal point and delete, rejects a third decimal digit and a second decimal point, and drops leading zeros ("007" reads "7")
The amount shows formatted as US dollar currency as the user types
"Continue" is enabled only for an amount above $0.00 and no more than the current balance
Money is held as Decimal, never a floating-point type
The confirmation screen shows the contact and the amount, and "Send" calls the account client
A successful send lowers the balance by the amount and puts the payment at the top of the first screen's activity list
A failed send leaves the balance unchanged and shows an error with a way to try again
